external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Dan Hoffman has been actively involved in building the support ecosystem for new Nebraska enterprises for over 13 years working with a variety of public and private sector partners. He currently serves on the Board of Directors for NMotion and the Advisory Board for the University of Nebraska President Ted Carter. In 2017, Dan was awarded the Entrepreneurship Advocate Award by the University of Nebraska-Lincoln Entrepreneurship Center.
